verdict.rationale: BVNK documents a Transfers v.3 API for wallet-to-wallet currency conversion, with conversion modeled as a property of a transfer, digest-based quote acceptance, mandatory idempotency, and a migration guide. Fiat and crypto wallets can be created and managed through the Portal or API, and rules can automate fiat-to-crypto movement, so moving value between fiat and stablecoin balances is a first-party capability. Missing for 10: evidence of initiating transfers or rebalancing from the dashboard (only wallet management is shown there), end-to-end transfer endpoint walkthroughs beyond the migration guide, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
